hints.title: Two Conditions to Open a Box
hints.text: To open box b, you must both possess the box and have it unlocked either initially or via its key.

hints.title: Queue Ready Boxes
hints.text: Enqueue a box when both status is open and it has been found. Keep sets or boolean flags for possessed boxes and acquired keys.

hints.title: Process Unlocked Children
hints.text: When opening a box, collect candies, add its contained keys, and mark contained boxes as found, enqueuing newly unlockable boxes.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: E: total number of keys and contained box links
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly scanning all boxes to check whether newly found keys unlock anything leads to quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Event-driven queue activates boxes as soon as their dual requirement (found + unlocked) is fulfilled.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate models box reachability with boolean arrays tracking box possession and key acquisition.
complexity.notes: Every box is enqueued and opened at most once.
